learning_boundary.student_regime: NOSL: one observation_v4 prompt and one action generation, no online search
learning_boundary.teacher_regime: SL: privileged simulator search with rollout access and exact simulator state
learning_boundary.claim_limit: Teacher-win/SFT-loss is a gap locator, not proof that the Teacher action is learnable by NOSL imitation.
learning_boundary.promotion_rule: Require repeated visible-state pattern plus counterfactual stability across hidden orders/seeds before constructing a student target.
